title: SB183 (133rd Legislature (2019-2020)): Limit transfers of firearms/require background checks

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Ohio) (gun-policy Stage 5, Ohio); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Ohio text (As Introduced (00_IN), ; official copy, https://search-prod.lis.state.oh.us/api/v2/general_assembly_133/legislation/sb183/00_IN/pdf/ (Open States text id 90125147))
provenance.note: As introduced. Division (G) lists exceptions (temporary transfers at ranges or hunting, law-enforcement, gunsmith, museum, etc.). 2929.28 and 5122.311 amendments only add the fine for the new offence and let the attorney general's mental-health record check serve dealers and agencies; all tied to the gun rule.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.26): (B) No federally licensed firearms dealer shall transfer a firearm to any person unless the federally licensed firearms dealer complies with the requirements of 18 U.S.C. 922(t).
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.26): (C)(1) No unlicensed transferor shall transfer a firearm to an unlicensed transferee, unless both of the following apply with respect to the transfer of the firearm: (a) The firearm is transferred through a federally licensed firearms dealer under division (E) of this section, through a law enforcement agency under division (F) of this section, or in accordance with an exception described in division (G) of this section.
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.26): (E)(2) Conduct an incompetency records check of the unlicensed transferee by contacting the attorney general and requesting a check of the records maintained under section 5122.311 of the Revised Code, to determine if the transfer of the firearm to the unlicensed transferee or the unlicensed transferee's acquisition or possession of the firearm would violate the law of this state;
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.26): (H) A federally licensed firearms dealer or law enforcement agency that processes the transfer of a firearm under this section may assess and collect a fee, in an amount not to exceed ten dollars, with respect to each firearm transfer processed.
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.26): (J) (1) No person shall recklessly violate division (B), (C), or (D) of this section.
Section 1 (new R.C. 2923.26): (a) Except as otherwise provided in division (J)(2)(b) or (c) of this section, illegal transfer of a firearm is a misdemeanor of the fourth degree and the offender shall be fined an amount from the range of possible fines for a misdemeanor of the fourth degree set forth in section 2929.28 of the Revised Code.
